items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: I ran into Little Bo's (?) band again. ... He was the leader.

ctx.x: So I had to come out here, see about my place o' business. So I had my sister runnin' it for me. 'Course, in the meantime, I went to Chicago. I lived seventeen years in Chicago. I got married in Chicago to a lady called Louella Brown. So we got together...Cut it off [the tape recorder].
So I left back East and come to Chicago. I ran into Little Bo's (?) band again. I run into Sheila Guys again. They was workin' in a nightclub there.
Who was in that band? How big a band was it?
